messages:
maria: Hey team — need to provision a new GPU nodepool in us-west3 for an embeddings-heavy service. Goal: steady ~20 pods, burst to ~60. Prefer A10G for perf, but want T4/spot fallback. Quota looks like it might block us. Any guidance on sizing, taints, and CA strategy?

jake: What’s the expected pods/node and p95 token latency target? That'll drive node sizing.

maria: Each pod needs 1 GPU, ~8GB GPU mem working set, CPU light (2 vcpu), p95 latency target ~150ms/token. Expect 20 steady concurrent pods (prod), spikes up to 60 during jobs.

anika: Quick quota check: current GPU quota in us-west3 = A10G: 18, T4: 40. So A10G is the blocker. We need a quota bump request for A10G before we can land the full pool. :warning:

leo: My 2c: create two nodepools not one mixed SKU pool — simpler scheduling and autoscaler behaviour. Proposal:
- nodepool-a10g: min=3 max=20, dedicated (no preemptible)
- nodepool-t4-spot: min=0 max=40, preemptible/spot for burst fallback
Add node taints and labels so pods can prefer A10G via tolerations/affinity. Use podPriority for critical vs burst.

maria: rough gcloud/Terraform snippet to start (will put in TF):
```
gcloud container node-pools create nodepool-a10g \
  --cluster=prod-usw3 \
  --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-a10g,count=1 \
  --min-nodes=3 --max-nodes=20 \
  --node-taints=gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule \
  --labels=gpu-type=a10g
```
(we'll mirror for t4 with preemptible and max 40)

kevin: CA flags we should set: --scale-down-delay-after-add=10m, --expander=least-waste, --skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false, and set --balance-similar-node-groups to true. Also enable CA NodeGroupAutoDiscovery by label (gpu-type). Example args in cluster-autoscaler helm values.

jake: I'll open the quota request now with cloud console (A10G -> 50). Also check subnet IPs — prod subnet only has ~5 free NAT IPs left which could block new nodes getting external egress.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-123 — quota request: A10G increase to 50 in us-west3. Request submitted to cloud support, estimated response 48-72h.

anika: For pod scheduling: create PriorityClass realtime-critical (value 100000) and best-effort-burst (value 1000). Pods that require low latency get realtime-critical + nodeAffinity to label gpu-type=a10g. Burst jobs get best-effort-burst and toleration for gpu=spot so they can land on t4-spot. Example toleration: { key: "gpu", value: "spot", effect: "NoSchedule" }.

leo: Small follow-up: set autoscaler expander to "priority"? CA’s priority expander needs labels + priorities configured; otherwise least-waste is safer until we verify behavior. Also add a scale-up cooldown to avoid oscillation.

maria: Great — action items: Jake (quota + subnet IPs), Leo (TF PR for two nodepools + labels/taints), Kevin (CA helm values + flags), Anika (PriorityClasses + tolerations doc). I'll draft the TF plan and post in this thread when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: will do, putting CA arg changes in infra PR and linking here when ready.

maria: Thanks — will pause the rollout until quota + NAT IPs confirmed.
